title: The page the person said yes to becomes a module whose parts fill a thing they add

steps.remove_module: Car Wash Site Screener — Austin, gates-first

steps.say: I want help picking car wash sites to open. It's for me, to decide which sites to pursue. Sites come from brokers by email, but for now I'll type the address. Today I check households within 3 miles (at least 45,000) and the traffic on the road (at least 30,000 cars a day), then I score the site and write a short memo. Start with Austin, Texas. Go ahead and write it up.
steps.reply: I've flagged this because it changes the result a lot — go ahead and answer the card whenever you're ready, and I'll pick up the build from there.
